title: Code and certificates for "Isotropy, not the Maxwellian, decides where solar 8B neutrinos can exactly mimic dark matter in xenon"
description: Analysis code and interval-arithmetic certificates for the paper "Isotropy, not the Maxwellian, decides where solar 8B neutrinos can exactly mimic dark matter in xenon". The pipeline computes the convex cone of dark-matter recoil spectra for arbitrary and for isotropic halos on the released XENONnT light-WIMP response and on an ideal xenon detector, the exact degeneracy window with solar 8B coherent neutrino scattering, the halo-independent discovery limit and neutrino-fog index, background-corrected and profiled separation exposures, annual modulation, and the CaWO4 complementarity forecast. Two standalone certificates (exact rational interval arithmetic; Arb ball arithmetic via python-flint) prove the convexity lemma and the natural-xenon upper edge. fetch_data.sh downloads the public inputs (XENONnT release v0.0.1, CRESST-III Detector A, solar fluxes) and checks their SHA-256 hashes; run_all.sh rebuilds every number, table and figure with one command.
